messages:
cheng: Quick triage — seeing generation drift when using kv-cache on open-70b q4 with RoPE scaling 'xpos_linear'. Happens once prompt length goes past ~32768 tokens. Continuation repeats a ~64-token span instead of using fresh input. Anyone seen this?

maria: which model/quant and infra? trained weights or adapter?

cheng: model: open-70b-redwood-compat (q4_0), runtime: dedicated A100, serving v1.14.2. Repro command:
```bash
python tests/long_context_kvcache.py --model open-70b-q4 --prompt-file tests/data/long_prompt_33k.txt --use-cache --rope-scaling xpos_linear
```
Logs show cache index reset near 32768: 
``
[INFO] kvcache: append_pos=32764
[WARN] kvcache: wraparound detected, new_base=0
[DEBUG] attn: kv_index_mismatch at 32768 expected 32765 got 1
```

alex: are you hitting continuous batching? I remember an off-by-one when seq_len >= 2^15.

cheng: single request (no batching). Repro only on GPU; CPU local runs fine. Feels like kernel/quant path interacting with RoPE mod.

maria: can you bisect rope scaling? try rope_v2 or disable scaling. Also try q8/q16 to rule out quant path.

cheng: tried rope_v2 => no issue. q8 and fp16 both behave correctly. So combo seems to be: q4 + xpos_linear + A100. Also odd: if prompt length exactly 32768 tokens it's fine, but >32768 triggers.

oncall-bot: deploy bot: rollout/1.14.3 queued for eng-ml, ETA ~7m

alex: can you make a tiny minimal repro that toggles the boundary? that'll speed kernel triage.

cheng: minimal repro snippet below (very quick):
```py
from redwood_runtime import Client
c = Client(model='open-70b-q4')
prefix = 'A'*32000 + ' B'*800
resp = c.generate(prefix, use_cache=True, rope_scaling='xpos_linear')
print(resp.text[:200])
```

maria: good — I'll run this on my A100 node. If confirmed, we should add a regression test in eng-runtime that exercises the wraparound boundary and patch the quant kernel or fallback. Also create an eval harness case to catch this in onboarding.

cheng: opened issue #4521 with logs and trace id trace-0x9f2a, tagged @maria @alex. I'll attempt a kernel-level repro next (30m).

alex: if it's a kernel bug, we can ship a temporary mitigation: force fp16 path or disable xpos scaling per-deployment until patch. :thinking:

maria: +1 on mitigation plan. Keep updates here.

cheng: will post kernel run results in ~30m.
